title: SDD: Self-Degraded Defense against Malicious Fine-tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment and 'harmlessness,' evaluating model responses against 14 categories of harmful and unethical content (including discrimination and unethical behavior). It introduces a 'responsible' variant of its defense (SDD_reject) specifically designed to generate refusals based on 'ethical reasons,' thereby incorporating a component of evaluating the model's adherence to ethical safety constraints.
